clips.vo: Zephyr Kreye. Six foot five, two hundred twenty pounds. Quarterback, Anna High School, class of twenty twenty-seven.

clips.headline: Throws from inside his own end zone — 90-yard TD
clips.note: same snap the source reel also showed from a wider angle at 0:30; that angle's scoreboard is what pins the situation
clips.vo: Anna backed up on their own goal line. Kreye takes it in his own end zone, pressure in his face, and lets it go. Nobody catches him. Ninety yards. Touchdown, Coyotes.

clips.headline: Off-platform throw on the move — completion at the 50
clips.note: moves to his non-throwing side, keeps his eyes up, releases at 0:44.1
clips.vo: Edge comes free. Kreye slides left, throws across his body, on the money at the fifty.

clips.headline: 29-yard touchdown pass
clips.note: confirmed by the Hudl card in-clip and the stadium ribbon board
clips.vo: First and ten at the twenty-nine. Kreye works right and finds number one in the flat. He's got blockers. Pylon. Touchdown.

clips.headline: Holds 3.5 seconds, throws on time — big gain to the 20
clips.note: still square and upright at 0:09.0 before the ball comes out
clips.vo: Watch the clock in his head. Two seconds. Three. Still square, still climbing, and now he turns it loose.

clips.headline: Deep ball down the boundary — about 30 yards to #2
clips.vo: Kreye takes his shot down the right boundary. Number two runs under it. Thirty yards, down inside the twenty.

clips.headline: Ball placed where only #2 can play it — catch at the 3
clips.note: defender draped on him through the catch
clips.vo: Red zone, tight man coverage. He puts it where only his guy can get it.

clips.headline: Pocket collapses — steps up, escapes, runs it
clips.note: will not take the sack; gain is right around the line to gain
clips.vo: Third and five. The pocket caves, but he will not go down. Steps up, and he's gone.
